text_en: Lots of red pimples and blackheads on my forehead and chin, and my face gets oily by midday.
Painful spots keep popping up on my back and shoulders, some of them with white heads.
my face is full of zits and blackheads and it's so embarrassing
My knees and fingers ache and feel stiff for the first hour after I wake up, and the joints look swollen.
It hurts to grip things because my wrist joints are swollen and stiff, and walking up stairs is painful.
my joints are killing me every morning, everything feels stiff and puffy
I get tightness in my chest and a whistling sound when I breathe out, especially at night or after running.
Cold air makes me short of breath and I start wheezing and coughing until I use my inhaler.
can't catch my breath when I run, chest feels tight and I wheeze
The back of my neck is stiff and sore, and the pain spreads into my shoulder and down my arm.
Turning my head is painful, my neck clicks, and I sometimes feel dizzy with tingling in my hands.
neck has been stiff for weeks and the pain shoots into my shoulder
My son has small itchy blisters all over his chest and face, plus a mild fever and he is very tired.
Red spots turned into fluid-filled blisters that itch like crazy, and they are spreading from my belly to my back.
kid is covered in itchy spots that look like little water bubbles
Stuffy nose, constant sneezing and a scratchy throat that started two days ago, with a mild cough.
My nose won't stop running, my throat is a bit sore and I keep sneezing, but I don't feel very ill.
got the sniffles, sneezing all day and my throat is scratchy
Sudden very high fever, a pounding headache, pain behind my eyes and my bones and joints ache terribly.
After the fever started I got a red rash on my arms, intense muscle pain and I feel nauseous.
crazy high fever, my whole body aches and it hurts behind my eyes
There is bright red blood on the toilet paper and it hurts when I pass stool, with itching around my anus.
I feel a painful lump near my bottom and going to the toilet is uncomfortable, sometimes with bleeding.
it hurts to poop and there's blood when I wipe
An itchy red patch shaped like a ring has appeared on my groin, and the edges are scaly.
The skin between my toes is itchy, peeling and red, and there are small rashes spreading on my foot.
itchy red circle on my skin that keeps getting bigger
I have frequent headaches at the back of my head, I feel dizzy at times and my chest feels heavy.
Recently I get headaches, my vision goes blurry for a moment and I feel lightheaded and unsteady.
headaches all the time and I get dizzy when I stand up fast
Red sores appeared around my child's nose and mouth, they burst and left yellow crusts that itch.
I have oozing sores on my face that dried into honey-coloured crusts, and I had a slight fever.
crusty yellow sores around my mouth that keep spreading
The whites of my eyes and my skin have turned yellow, my urine is very dark and I feel tired.
My skin looks yellow, I am itching all over, my stools are pale and there is pain on the right side of my belly.
my eyes look yellow and my pee is dark like tea
Every couple of days I get shaking chills, then a high fever and heavy sweating, with headache and vomiting.
Since my trip I have had fever that comes and goes with chills, body aches, nausea and sweating at night.
fever and chills that come back every other day and I sweat buckets
A throbbing headache on one side of my head, bright light hurts my eyes and I feel like throwing up.
Before the headache starts I see flashing zigzag lines, then the pain is pulsing and I need a dark room.
horrible one-sided headache, light hurts and I feel sick
I am coughing up thick yellow mucus, I have fever and chills and it hurts in my chest when I breathe in.
High fever, fast breathing, sharp chest pain and a cough with green phlegm, and I feel extremely weak.
bad cough with gunk, fever and it hurts to breathe
Thick red patches covered with silvery scales on my elbows and knees, and the skin cracks and bleeds.
My scalp has scaly plaques that itch and flake, and my fingernails have small pits in them.
dry flaky silver patches on my elbows that itch
For over a week I have had a fever that keeps rising, stomach pain, weakness and no appetite.
Persistent high fever, headache, constipation and abdominal pain, and I feel very weak and tired.
fever won't go away for days, tummy hurts and I'm weak
The veins on my calves are twisted and bulging, and my legs feel heavy and ache at the end of the day.
Blue swollen veins on my legs, my ankles swell in the evening and I get cramps at night.
ugly bulging veins on my legs and they ache
Whenever I am near cats my eyes get red, itchy and watery and I start sneezing over and over.
In spring my nose runs, my eyes itch and I sneeze a lot, especially when the pollen count is high.
sneezing and itchy watery eyes every time I dust the house
I am always thirsty, I urinate many times a day, I feel hungry and I have lost weight without trying.
I feel tired all the time, my vision is blurry and small cuts take a long time to heal.
always thirsty and peeing like crazy, losing weight too
Two days after starting new antibiotics I got an itchy red rash all over my body and my lips are swollen.
Since I began taking a new medicine I have hives, itching and a fever.
broke out in an itchy rash after the new pills
Burning in my chest after meals and when I lie down, with a sour taste coming up into my mouth.
Food and acid come back up into my throat, I have heartburn most nights and a hoarse voice in the morning.
heartburn every night and acid coming up my throat
A gnawing burning pain in my upper stomach that gets better when I eat and returns a few hours later.
I have burning pain in the stomach, bloating, nausea and my stools have become black.
burning pain in my stomach when it's empty
It burns when I pee, I need to go all the time and only a little comes out, and my urine smells strong.
Cloudy urine, pressure in my lower belly and a stinging feeling every time I urinate.
burns when I pee and I have to go every ten minutes
